testPlan.title: release check: road runs + spline cards

test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: Road runs: short card, every row works
test.hint: With verbose logging off: lay as, priority, roads to find, lane gap, then picked and build. No view row. Each row changes what lights up or how it lays.

test.title: Road runs: pick, shape and build a road
test.hint: Pick a road, drag a handle, right-click: the run follows the shape (ticks itself).

test.title: Road runs: reshape a built two-lane road
test.hint: Click a built two-lane road, drag a handle, right-click: both lanes follow, all joins kept (ticks itself).

test.title: Settings dialog: ROAD RUNS rows change and stay
test.hint: Settings dialog: light up, side check, rig width, fork gap each change; close and reopen, they stay.

test.title: Spline: lay a multi-point curve
test.hint: Click points, drag one, ctrl-click one away, right-click lays it (ticks itself).

test.title: Spline: AutoDrive mode still lays a curve
test.hint: Switch curve by to AutoDrive, click two waypoints, wheel the curvature, lay it.
